fields.label: Upstream Paid Proxy URL
fields.description: Upstream residential/datacenter proxy endpoint that costs bandwidth

fields.label: Local Intercepting Proxy Port
fields.description: Local port to listen for incoming client HTTP/CONNECT traffic (0 to disable local proxy server)

fields.label: Block Analytics (GA, GTM, Pixel, Hotjar)
fields.description: Intercept Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Hotjar, Clarity

fields.label: Block Ad Networks & Trackers
fields.description: Intercept DoubleClick, Google Syndication, Criteo, Taboola, Outbrain

fields.label: Block Error Telemetry (Sentry, Datadog RUM)
fields.description: Intercept Sentry, Bugsnag, Datadog RUM, Segment, Amplitude

fields.label: Block Heavy Media (Images, Video, Audio)
fields.description: Intercept heavy PNG, JPG, WebP, MP4, WebM assets to save maximal bandwidth

fields.label: Proxy Cost ($ / GB)
fields.description: Price per Gigabyte of your paid upstream proxy for cost calculation

tools.name: evaluate_url
tools.description: Evaluates a target URL and method to determine if Proxy Guard will block, mock, or forward it, along with estimated bytes and dollar savings.

tools.name: optimize_flow
tools.description: Analyzes a complete batch flow (list of HTTP requests or HAR log entries), filters unnecessary requests, and computes total bandwidth and dollar savings.

requests.description: List of HTTP request objects with 'url', optional 'method', 'resource_type', and 'size_bytes'

tools.name: generate_script
tools.description: Generates production-ready browser automation interceptor code (Playwright, Puppeteer, or mitmproxy addon) with built-in zero-bandwidth filters.

tools.name: get_metrics
tools.description: Returns cumulative statistics on total requests processed, blocked requests, forwarded requests, bytes saved, and proxy cost saved in USD.

tools.name: configure_rules
tools.description: Configures filtering options, toggles categories (analytics, ads, media, fonts, telemetry), and manages whitelist/blacklist domains.
